We are incorporating artificial intelligence, or AI, and machine learning, or ML, technologies into aspects of our business.
AI and ML systems are complex and may generate inaccurate or unintended outputs due to design limitations, algorithmic flaws, or deficiencies in training data.
Our use of AI and ML may increase data privacy and intellectual property risks.
The regulatory landscape for AI is evolving rapidly.

Moreover, our clinical trials to support PMA approval must be conducted under an FDA-approved IDE.
